review_mode: Offline consistency review of user-exported cloud API records and local Git; no new cloud execution or authenticated direct query.

checks.detail: All 15 inventory entries match the original files and SHA256 values; inventory excludes itself.
Uploaded collector matches the previously prepared collector; uploaded code was not executed.
Six downloaded GCS objects match recorded sizes, SHA256 and MD5; object generations are preserved. No fresh GCS reads performed.
Job and all four named container tasks succeeded; each task has an actual CustomJob reference.
Four sequential executions, with upstream completion before downstream start; no CACHED task state.
Task output/input artifact URIs form fetch -> process -> validate -> retrieve.

Exact run-commit compilation matches cloud pipelineSpec after only disabling four enableCache defaults and removing the identical typed deploymentConfig alias. SDK submission explicitly sets enable_caching=False.
All four executors and both release manifests reference the same immutable workflow image.
Collected releases, report and retrieval objects belong to the exact run/task outputs.
Seven input/output manifest hashes agree and each file URI is under its own release prefix; raw data objects were not re-downloaded.
Six Git-tracked data/manifest files at the run commit match the release hashes. Ignored vector snapshot bytes were not exported.
Validation, retrieval config and demo manifest agree on the three source hashes; validation and retrieval reference the same processed release.
Downloaded fixed benchmark universe matches the output release manifest.
Query-file hash matches Git at the recorded source commit; eight unique query IDs. No question/relevance analysis performed.
Exactly six methods x eight queries = 48 unique records; no missing or duplicate query/method pair.
Each record contains five distinct IDs within the fixed 50-trial universe. Structural check only; no scores or relevance judgements computed.
One successful digest/commit-matching build among all nine returned records; build completed before the pipeline. Commit is build-declared, not a separately verified clean source archive.
Input release address matches recorded build version, workflow digest and recomputed seven-file data fingerprint.
Current branch differs only in README and two frontend files. This cloud run remains attributed to 6cae15b, not 50dc2ca.
No common private-key or access-token literals found in the exported files; service-account identities are metadata, not credentials.

limitations: The original collector used the wrong log resource type. Eleven matching retrieve-trials log entries have now been independently reviewed and archived, confirming release verification, 48 rows and successful completion. Logs from the other three nodes remain uncollected; all four node states were already verified in the Vertex job record.
Runtime graph reviewed in chat: matching run ID, all four green nodes and 4/4 completed. Original image file still needs repository archiving.

Seven-file manifest identity and six tracked source files were checked. Cloud raw-data objects and ignored vector snapshot bytes were not independently re-downloaded; restoration/count evidence comes from the validation report.
Cloud Build source archive was not downloaded or compared to Git. The recorded source commit is corroborated by build substitutions and runtime config, not a cryptographic proof of a clean checkout.
This confirms a successful data/retrieval run. No negative-input cloud case, trainable-model training, human-reference scoring or clinical validation is included.
